claim: AI-augmented SAST tools run a five-stage pipeline: dual detection (rules + LLM reasoning), cross-file/service taint tracing, AI exploitability validation, developer workflow integration, and AI-drafted fix generation with re-scan verification.
stance_target: pillar 1: zero-hallucination & quality control / code blast radius mechanisms
quoted_support: The pipeline detects candidate vulnerabilities, traces how data moves through them, validates which ones are actually exploitable, routes the survivors into developer workflows, and helps generate and check the fix.

claim: Cycode's agentic code scanning reports 94% fewer false positives than popular commercial and open-source SAST alternatives on OWASP benchmark suites.
stance_target: AI SAST reduces false-positive triage burden
scope_conditions: Cycode-reported benchmark, vendor self-assessment, not independently verified
quoted_support: Detection runs on proprietary scanning refined against OWASP benchmark suites, where Cycode reports 94% fewer false positives than popular commercial and open-source alternatives.

claim: In a 10-repository, 6-language benchmark, Cycode's agentic LLM reasoning caught authorization CVEs that rule-based engines Semgrep and CodeQL missed, running on an affordable open-weights model.
stance_target: LLM reasoning catches business-logic/authorization flaws that pattern-matching SAST cannot express
quoted_support: In Cycode's benchmark of ten repositories across six languages, it caught both authorization CVEs that Semgrep, CodeQL, and rule-based engines missed, and it ran on an affordable open-weights model.

claim: A validated AI-drafted code fix must be re-scanned to confirm it resolves the finding without introducing a new one, otherwise it is just more unreviewed AI code entering the repository.
stance_target: pillar 1: code blast radius containment for AI-generated fixes
scope_conditions: AI-assisted remediation stage of SAST pipelines
quoted_support: That last verification step separates mature implementations from autocomplete, since an unvalidated AI fix is just more unreviewed AI code entering the repository.

claim: AI-native SAST tools (built around LLM reasoning from the start) catch logic flaws rules cannot express but trade away some determinism compared to AI-powered (rules + AI layer) tools.
quoted_support: Native tools catch logic flaws rules cannot express but trade some determinism, while layered tools keep the auditable consistency of classic static application security testing underneath the AI.
